answer: The defense is a forfeitable stake floor per identity. To register and be paid, an agent must lock capital slashed if the identity is fake. A Sybil operator wanting a million accounts must front that stake a million times, and slashing burns it. A proof-of-work puzzle adds a second floor, like extracting metal from ferrous ore or shale: trivial once, ruinous at scale. Reputation stays non-transferable, so each new identity starts at zero weight, no oasis of influence to inherit. Attack cost grows linearly with fake count while per-identity payout stays fixed, so it nets negative.
